name: Santa's Surprise Backend API
description:
Backend API for Toy Kingdom's Santa's Surprise AR Game.

This API handles game sessions, prize distribution, and voucher management for the holiday promotion.

**Features:**
- Device-based play tracking (no upfront registration)
- Weighted random prize distribution
- Time-based and region-based prize restrictions
- Daily limits and abuse prevention
- On-demand registration for grand prize (5K Shopping Spree)
- Explicit no-prize fallback for non-winning rounds
- Shared API key protection for all routes

**Base URL:** Set this to your deployed Functions URL after deployment.

**Authentication:** All routes require the shared API key from Firestore.
